verdict.rationale: Fathom documents a REST API, SDKs and a changelog of additive changes (new endpoints, new response fields). Nothing in the evidence shows explicit API versioning or a documented deprecation policy. A changelog is an adjacent artifact, not a versioning or deprecation guarantee, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
